text: ②じょうげで　なげたい　ボールを　えらびます。

structure.jp: なげたい　ボールを
structure.en: the Ball you want to throw

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says you use it to do the action. じょうげで = 'with Up and Down'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says you want to do it. なげたい = 'want to throw'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing tells you which thing. なげたい　ボール = 'the Ball you want to throw'.
